sourceProse.title: Posters with a clear hierarchy
sourceProse.description: Posters where one shape leads and every other element has a stated place.

reasons.p_045: Five annotated phrases show which words placed which shape.
reasons.p_002: The same structure as the jazz poster, with the disc and the half circle swapped.
reasons.p_022: Coral on cream: the hierarchy holds even with a light background.
reasons.t_001: The same idea for products: the template reserves the headline area.
reasons.p_076: A travel poster that uses stripes in the sky as its hierarchy.
reasons.p_010: Headline bars above, product below: the simplest two-level layout.

sourceProse.body:
Each of these prompts says where its shapes go. That single habit keeps flat posters from turning into confetti.

## What do they have in common?

- One dominant shape, named first and given a position.
- Bars instead of lettering, so the layout survives without readable text.
- Four colours at most, plus the background.

body.base:
这些提示词都写明了图形的位置。正是这个习惯，让扁平海报不会变成一堆碎纸屑。

## 它们有什么共同点？

- 有一个主导图形，最先出现并写明位置。
- 用色条代替文字，即使没有可读的文字，版面依然成立。
- 除背景外最多四种颜色。

sourceProse.title: Quiet landscapes
sourceProse.description: Layered ridges, still water and plenty of empty sky, for backgrounds that stay out of the way.

reasons.p_042: Mist does the work that detail would otherwise do.
reasons.p_016: Five layers fading into fog: the most depth with the least drawing.
reasons.p_001: A warmer version with a low sun between the ridges.
reasons.t_002: Turn any of these into an ink painting with the scroll template.
reasons.p_088: At 3:1 the horizon alone is the subject.
reasons.p_098: Two annotated phrases show how the moon and the dark foreground were placed.

sourceProse.body:
Landscapes built from a few layered shapes. They work behind text because nothing in them asks for attention.

## How do I keep a landscape quiet?

- Order the layers from light to dark instead of adding detail.
- Name one light source and its position.
- Leave the sky empty; it is where the text goes.

body.base:
由少数几层图形构成的风景。放在文字后面也合适，因为画面里没有任何东西争夺注意力。

## 怎样让风景保持安静？

- 用由浅到深的层次代替细节。
- 只写一个光源及其位置。
- 让天空保持空白，那里是放文字的地方。

sourceProse.title: Image 2.6 social prompts — original-language tests
sourceProse.description: Eleven original-language static prompt tests, including a successful street-portrait retry, with project-generated references.
sourceProse.body:
## Tested static prompts

Eleven accepted examples use complete author prompts in their original language. Reference images are generated by this project. The street portrait succeeded on retry; four other static cases remain rejected by the image tool.

Authors identify their source work as Image 2.6. Our tool reports GPT Image without an exact model version. The list follows original X-post likes observed on November 7, 2026; these are whole-post snapshots, not engagement for our examples or a cross-platform ranking.

## Separate adaptations

See the [26 nine-frame composed GIFs](collection:c_016), made from archived GPT Image frames. These are local adaptations, not native GIF output. The [four everyday portrait adaptations](collection:c_017) cover the remaining scenes with separately rewritten prompts. The separate [selfie workflow example](prompt:p_273) uses one image call and an assistant-authored Japanese message; it is an independent adaptation.

body.base:
## 已验收的静态原词

11 个示例使用完整作者原词，正文保持原语言，参考底图由本站生成。街拍人像重试成功；另 4 个静态案例仍被工具拒绝。

来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本站调用仅能确认 GPT Image 家族，未获得精确版本。按 2026 年 11 月 7 日观察到的原 X 帖点赞排序，统计属于整篇来源帖，不属于本站新图，也不是跨平台排行榜。

## 独立改编

另有 [26 个九帧合成 GIF](collection:c_016)，由已归档 GPT Image 动作素材在本地合成，独立记录为改编。另有[四个日常人像改编](collection:c_017)，以独立改写词覆盖剩余场景。[自拍工作流示例](prompt:p_273)通过单次生图和助手另写日语消息完成，作为独立改编单独记录。

sourceProse.title: English Reactions and Social Images
sourceProse.description: 12 tested image prompts for English reaction stickers, photo-booth memories, pet stories and birthday cards.
sourceProse.body:
## Reaction stickers

Six nine-panel reaction sheets cover everyday replies, dog moods, office chats, social energy, encouragement and gaming. The portrait and dog sets need one reference photo each; the cat, raccoon, frog and ghost sets work from text alone. Each sheet is a single image to share. Exporting individual stickers is a separate workflow.

## Photo edits and shareable images

Make a two-person photo booth, a fictional pet newspaper, a two-panel meme, a weekend collage, a birthday card or a four-panel dog comic. The collage needs no reference photo; the other five need one or two as described in their input instructions. The three demonstration references are AI-generated. All image captions and generation prompts are in English, including on translated pages. Edit the nine captions in the six sticker templates or the name and age in the birthday template.

body.base:
## 表情九宫格

六套九宫格涵盖日常回复、宠物心情、职场聊天、社交电量、鼓励和游戏反应。人物与狗狗两套各需要一张参考照片；橘猫、浣熊、青蛙和幽灵可以直接用文字生成。每套是一张可分享的图片，独立贴纸导出属于另一项工作。

## 照片编辑与社交图片

制作双人照片亭、虚构宠物报纸、上下两格梗图、周末拼贴、生日卡或四格宠物漫画。拼贴无需参考图，其余五项按输入说明提供一到两张。三张示例底图均由 AI 生成。所有图片配文和生成提示词保持英文，翻译页面也使用相同英文正文。六套表情模板可修改九条配文，生日模板可修改姓名与年龄。

sourceProse.title: Social animations — 26 nine-frame composed GIFs
sourceProse.description: Nine-frame adaptations made from GPT Image action sheets, with source prompts, references and documented playback.
sourceProse.body: Each GIF contains nine encoded frames, composed locally from archived GPT Image artwork. Eight-pose sources split one held pose into two encoded frames; longer sequences select nine poses. Total duration and loop settings are preserved. These are independent adaptations, not native GIF output or exact original-prompt tests. Small source cells may be enlarged without adding detail. The original prompt language is preserved. See also the [original static tests](collection:c_013).

See the [original static tests](collection:c_013) and [nine-frame GIF adaptations](collection:c_016).

sourceProse.title: About Prompt Seen
sourceProse.description: What this library is, how prompts are tested, and what the sample entries are.
sourceProse.body:
Prompt Seen is a library of image prompts you can read, copy and adapt. Every entry shows the image it produced and marks which phrases in the prompt changed what.

## How are prompts tested?

Each prompt is run with a recorded model, date and parameters. The record is kept with the prompt as an example run, and the page shows when it was last tested. Entries with no recorded run are marked “Not verified”.

## What are the sample entries?

The 101 content images were generated with GPT Image using the prompts shown on their pages. Each has a recorded run and a visual review. The built-in tool does not expose the exact model snapshot or usage. Downloadable full-size images may use a lossless format conversion; display sizes are compressed separately. The earlier procedural sample runs are archived.

## How do I report a problem?

Open an issue in the project's repository for wrong information, broken pages or a licensing concern.

body.base:
Prompt Seen 是一个可以阅读、复制和改写的图像提示词资源库。每个条目都展示它生成的图像，并标出提示词中哪些短语改变了什么。

## 提示词怎样测试？

每条提示词都会在记录了模型、日期和参数的条件下运行。记录作为生成示例与提示词一起保存，页面显示最后测试的日期。没有运行记录的条目标为“未验证”。

## 样例条目是什么？

101 张内容图片均由 GPT Image 根据页面展示的提示词生成，并保留运行记录和视觉审核。内置工具未提供精确模型快照或用量。可下载的大图可能经过无损格式转换，展示尺寸另行压缩。此前的程序绘图样例运行已归档。

## 怎样报告问题？

如发现信息错误、页面损坏或许可问题，请在项目仓库中提交 issue。

sourceProse.title: Layered ridges at dusk
sourceProse.description: Layered ridges at dusk as a flat-vector landscape, suited to desktop and phone wallpapers.
sourceProse.body:
## What is it good for?

A calm, low-detail image that sits behind icons and text without competing with them.

## How do I adjust it?

- Change the number of ridges to control depth: three feels open, five feels layered.
- Name the time of day instead of listing colours; the sky gradient follows it.

body.base:
## 适合用在哪里？

画面平静、细节少，放在图标和文字后面也不会喧宾夺主。

## 怎样调整？

- 改变山脊的数量来控制纵深：三层显得开阔，五层显得层次丰富。
- 写出一天中的时刻，而不是逐个列出颜色，天空的渐变会随之变化。

sourceProse.title: Geometric concert poster
sourceProse.description: Geometric concert poster as a Bauhaus-style poster, suited to event posters.
sourceProse.body:
## What is it good for?

Bold geometry that stays legible from across a room, with bars reserved for event details.

## How do I adjust it?

- Give every shape a position (upper right, lower left); the layout stays balanced.
- Keep the palette to four colours plus the background.

body.base:
## 适合用在哪里？

醒目的几何图形，隔着一个房间也看得清，并预留了放活动信息的色条。

## 怎样调整？

- 为每个图形指定位置（右上、左下），版面会保持平衡。
- 配色控制在背景色之外的四种颜色以内。

sourceProse.title: Tea can on a sage backdrop
sourceProse.description: Tea can on a sage backdrop as a flat-vector product illustration, suited to packaging and labels.
sourceProse.body:
## What is it good for?

Keeps the product shape readable and leaves a clean area for a label or logo.

## How do I adjust it?

- Describe the object's silhouette first, then the label; the label stays in proportion.
- A soft circular backdrop separates a pale product from a pale wall.
- To change the subject or colours, start from the [product poster template](template:t_001).

body.base:
## 适合用在哪里？

产品轮廓清晰，并为标签或标志留出干净的区域。

## 怎样调整？

- 先描述物体的轮廓，再描述标签，标签的比例会更准确。
- 柔和的圆形背景能把浅色产品和浅色墙面区分开。
- 想换主体或配色，可以从[产品海报模板](template:t_001)开始。

sourceProse.title: Sailboat at sunset
sourceProse.description: Sailboat at sunset as a flat-vector landscape, suited to framed art prints.
sourceProse.body:
## What is it good for?

Flat shapes and a limited palette print cleanly at large sizes and look deliberate on a wall.

## How do I adjust it?

- Move the horizon with words like “low horizon” or “high horizon” to change the mood.
- Ask for horizontal reflection lines to keep the water flat and graphic.

body.base:
## 适合用在哪里？

平涂色块和有限的配色在大尺寸印刷时依然干净，挂在墙上显得有设计感。

## 怎样调整？

- 用“低地平线”或“高地平线”这样的词移动海平线，可以改变氛围。
- 要求水平的倒影线条，水面会保持平整、图形化。

sourceProse.title: Neon rim-lit profile
sourceProse.description: Neon rim-lit profile as a neon-lit portrait, suited to profile pictures and avatars.
sourceProse.body:
## What is it good for?

Works when cropped to a circle: the subject sits in the centre with a simple background.

## How do I adjust it?

- Name two rim colours, one for each side, to keep the outline readable.
- Keep the face in shadow; detail inside the silhouette breaks the effect.
- To change the subject or colours, start from the [neon portrait template](template:t_003).

body.base:

- 让面部保持在阴影里；剪影内部的细节会破坏效果。

- Mention a pot or a cropped edge to decide whether the plant floats or stands.

sourceProse.title: 3x3 product campaign from one reference photo
sourceProse.description: Copy the recorded product campaign prompt and compare two nine-panel outputs with the same synthetic PINE bottle reference.
sourceProse.body:
## How to use

Upload one product photo; supply a palette and exactly nine scene themes.

Keep the product silhouette, cap and label consistent in every panel.

## Recorded result

The two test prints use the same synthetic PINE bottle reference, not a customer product photo. The default run uses sage green, ivory and brushed silver; the alternate run changes the palette and nine scene descriptions. Each print below pairs its input with its own output and submitted prompt.

Both outputs contain nine panels. The bottle, silver cap and PINE lettering remain recognizable in the product views; the material and paint close-ups do not show a whole bottle. These are observations of these two outputs, not a guarantee for other packaging or small label text.

## Generation evidence and limits

The [default run record](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/content/examples/x_168/run.yaml) and [alternate run record](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/content/examples/x_196/run.yaml) preserve prompt hashes, ordered reference IDs and output IDs. Both were recorded on October 29, 2026 using the built-in image tool.

The GPT Image 2.5 display version comes from the [project owner's version attribution](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/production/model-version-annotation-2026-11-05.json). The tool returned no exact API model ID. Seed, sampling settings and quality settings were not recorded; the empty parameter record does not establish defaults. Reusing the prompt does not guarantee identical pixels.

Use the [campaign template](template:t_017) to change the palette or scenes. A changed prompt or product photo is an untested variant: check panel count, product shape and lettering against your own reference before using the result.

## How to use

## Reference map

The supplied guide uses the main-island outline and city points from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/), a public-domain dataset. It is a generalized illustration, with smaller outlying islands omitted.

## Map scope

A schematic illustration of the main islands, with decorative relief and landmarks. The rendered map is not a navigation map; inspect label placement against the supplied reference before publication.

## Checked destination names

City attractions were cross-checked against [GO TOKYO](https://www.gotokyo.org/en/see-and-do/attractions/) and [Kyoto Travel](https://kyoto.travel/en/getting-around/). Decorative landmark miniatures are not map coordinates.

sourceProse.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

The elevated three-quarter view exposes the sculptural lid top and hollow side handle, preserving the reference speckled ceramic and gold collar.

## Generation evidence and limits

This example uses one synthetic ceramic perfume-bottle reference. It asks for a new camera angle on seamless white, not a new package design. Compare the cap, collar, handle opening and body proportions with the reference shown in the test print. The output is a generated interpretation; this single example does not establish exact geometry from unseen sides.

## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt and the displayed original reference assets in order. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

The [run record](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/content/examples/x_282/run.yaml) links the prompt hash to inputs a_373 and a_374, in that order, and output a_372. Its timestamp is November 5 UTC, corresponding to November 4 in Los Angeles, the date displayed for this run.

GPT Image 2.6 is the [project owner's version attribution](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/production/model-version-annotation-2026-11-05.json). 按显示顺序上传 1 张本站生成的参考图（R11），使用完整改编词。

复用已生成的 GPT Image 精灵图，统一合成 9 帧：8 姿态素材将一次停留拆成两个编码帧，不新增姿态，较长序列按顺序选取 9 帧。保留总时长与循环设置，小尺寸素材仅放大显示，不增加细节。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

9 帧，1.6 秒，443×443 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

原始素材审核说明（以下帧数和尺寸指原始版本；当前交付统一为 9 帧）：8 帧低头、流泪、擦泪后恢复，大小和线条略有变化。四种情绪分别进行独立生图调用，共享同一来源帖。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@tetumemo 的原词](https://x.com/tetumemo/status/2118129204449697985)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。

同帖变体：[企鹅：喜](prompt:p_301) · [企鹅：怒](prompt:p_302) · [企鹅：乐](prompt:p_304)

sourceProse.description: 9 frames, 1.6 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.
sourceProse.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R11), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Reuse the archived GPT Image sheet and resample its action to nine frames. Sources with eight poses split one held pose across two encoded frames without adding a new pose; longer sequences select nine chronological poses. Preserve total duration and loop settings. Small source cells are enlarged for display without adding detail. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

9 frames, 1.6 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Reviewed all nine-frame sequences in four contact sheets: action order, identity, captions and final poses retained. This output reuses archived GPT Image source pixels; no new provider call. One held pose is split into two frames; eight distinct source poses, nine encoded frames. Total duration and playback count preserved. Original source review (frame counts describe source only): Eight distinct poses show smiling side-to-side dance with alternating wings and feet. Minor redraw variation and neutral reset remain.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@tetumemo's original prompt](https://x.com/tetumemo/status/2118129204449697985). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

Variants from the same source post: [Penguin joy](prompt:p_301) · [Penguin anger](prompt:p_302) · [Penguin sorrow](prompt:p_303)

sourceProse.title: Product poster
sourceProse.description: Fill in a product, up to three selling points, a palette and a ratio to get a clean flat-vector product poster.
sourceProse.body:
## What is it good for?

Shop banners, launch posts and packaging mock-ups where the product shape has to read instantly.

## How do I fill it in?

- **Product**: name the object and its material, such as “a speckled ceramic mug”. The material decides the surface texture.
- **Selling points**: up to three short phrases. Concrete ones (“airtight lid”) turn into visible details; vague ones (“premium”) are ignored.
- **Headline**: optional. Version 3 requests the supplied headline exactly and leaves the bars blank when it is empty. Check the lettering in each result.

## What changed in version 2?

Version 2 adds the optional headline, a grey and a coral palette, and more ratios. Examples made with version 1 keep their original prompt.

body.base:
## 适合用在哪里？

店铺横幅、上新帖子和包装样稿——需要一眼看清产品轮廓的场合。

## 怎样填写？

- **产品**：写清物品和材质，如“带斑点的陶瓷马克杯”。材质决定表面质感。
- **卖点**：最多三个短语。具体的卖点（“密封盖”）会变成可见的细节；空泛的说法（“高端”）会被忽略。
- **标题文字**：可选。第 3 版要求准确呈现填写的标题；为空时保留空白色条。生成后仍需核对文字。

## 第 2 版改了什么？

第 2 版增加了可选的标题文字、灰色和珊瑚色两种配色，以及更多比例。用第 1 版生成的示例保留原来的提示词。

## 适合用在哪里？

横幅、长卷壁纸和需要东方气质的封面。宽幅比例下，留白比题材本身更重要。

## 怎样填写？

- **题材**：一个主体即可，如“竹林”“孤松”。题材越多，留白越少。
- **笔法**：决定画面质感。“湿笔晕染”柔和，“枯笔”粗粝。
- **细节**：最多四项，写可数的东西，如“五根竹竿”。

提示词正文保持英文，因为在测试中英文描述的笔法更稳定。

## How to use

Upload one product photo; supply a palette and exactly nine scene themes.

## Recorded result

This template has two recorded examples using the same synthetic PINE bottle reference. The default values produce the submitted text for the sage, ivory and silver campaign; the alternate values use charcoal, amber and outdoor scenes. The [tested campaign case](prompt:p_123) explains what was observed in each output.

## Generation evidence and limits

The [default run](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/content/examples/x_168/run.yaml) and [alternate run](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/content/examples/x_196/run.yaml) record template v1, submitted values, prompt hashes, reference IDs and output IDs on October 29, 2026. Upload the product reference shown with the matching test print; the template fields change the text, not the input image.

GPT Image 2.5 is the [project owner's version attribution](https://github.com/picontapLab/prompt-seen/blob/89395feb8e5fda7419aa3f5d2594df8a71fb3363/production/model-version-annotation-2026-11-05.json). The built-in image tool returned no exact API model ID, and no seed, sampling or quality settings were recorded. Matching the text and input does not guarantee identical pixels.

Editing fields creates a prompt, not a newly generated image. Values without a matching recorded run remain untested. Check the nine-panel layout, label text and product silhouette after generating with your own photo.

## Inspiration

See the [tested case](prompt:p_123) for original sources and dated attention metrics.

sourceProse.title: Landscape prompts
sourceProse.description: Flat-vector and ink landscapes: ridges, dunes and seas built from a few layered shapes.
sourceProse.body:
## How are these landscapes built?

Almost every landscape here is a stack of shapes ordered from light to dark, with one light source. The prompts name the number of layers and the time of day rather than individual colours.

## Which one should I start with?

- For a wallpaper: [Morning mist over the hills](prompt:p_016), which leaves the sky empty.
- For a print: [Desert dunes in warm light](prompt:p_006).
- For an ink painting: the [ink scroll template](template:t_002).

body.base:
## 这些风景是怎样构成的？

这里几乎每一幅风景都是由浅到深叠起来的几层图形，再加一个光源。提示词写的是层数和时刻，而不是逐个颜色。

## 从哪一个开始？

- 做壁纸：[晨雾中的山丘](prompt:p_016)，天空留白。
- 做印刷品：[暖光下的沙丘](prompt:p_006)。
- 做水墨画：[水墨长卷模板](template:t_002)。

Image models still garble text. These prompts reserve bars for titles and dates, so the layout survives and the words can be set afterwards.

See the collection [Posters with a clear hierarchy](collection:c_001).
